profile: coordinate descent: an optimization algorithm that examines one coordinate direction (and its negative) at a time, taking a step in that direction if it produces descent. Rather than collecting all coordinate directions and choosing a single best one, it steps immediately after examining each coordinate's positive and negative directions. This variant of coordinate search is much more effective at precisely the same computational cost. A related form of coordinate descent is especially effective when each per-coordinate equation can be solved in closed form.
